title: benchhand CEL expression types, provisional
description: Provisional: the CEL expression types (ADR-0014). Every CEL field of every contract refers to CelExpression or CelExpressions here, and that $ref is how the flow interpreter finds them all

CelExpression.description: A CEL expression. The interpreter compiles and type-checks it at load, against activation types generated from the contracts; the schema only checks that it is a non-empty string. x-cel is a readable annotation that nothing depends on

CelExpressions.description: One or more CEL expressions, each of which must hold
